links.outcome: Rate of consumer health questions routed to fallback model by safety filter (over-refusal)
links.effect: Fable 5 routed 243/500 (48.6%; 95% CI 44.2%-53.0%) prompts to fallback, versus the developer's stated <5% of sessions. A further 21/257 not-routed prompts (8.2%) were truncated midgeneration. Gemini declined 19% overall.
links.quote: Fable 5 routed 243 (48.6%; 95% CI 44.2%-53.0%) prompts to the fallback.

unlisted_practices: Auditing and reporting safety-filter fallback routing rates alongside answer quality

screen.reason: Empirical audit testing how an LLM's automated safety-filter fallback mechanism and refusal/truncation guardrail performs across consumer health questions from the HealthSearchQA benchmark.
